author: kaiomp
tagline: Swap models, tint your projects, and spin up pre-configured Claude Code terminals. Hit Enter twice. Work starts.
description: GhostCode is a Ghostty launcher for Claude Code. Fuzzy project picker, per-project color tints, provider/model/mode memory, all local, no telemetry.
features: Fuzzy project picker with starred favorites and auto-tracked recents
Per-project color tints that follow the project into CC's statusline
Model, effort, mode, and provider — saved per-project and globally
Providers beyond Claude: Anthropic API, GLM, Kimi, Qwen
First-run wizard installs dependencies and wires Ghostty config
useCases: Heavy Claude Code users who want a project switcher on every new terminal
Devs juggling multiple AI providers across projects
Anyone who wants visual distinction between project contexts
